name: dynamic_color
summary: Flutter package published by material.io that obtains platform dynamic/accent colors and exposes light and dark ColorScheme values, with support for color harmonization.
advantages: Can derive Material color schemes from supported platform-provided dynamic or accent colors
Provides light and dark dynamic ColorScheme values through DynamicColorBuilder
tradeoffs: Platform support is not uniform; current documented support includes Android S+, Linux, macOS, and Windows rather than every Flutter platform
Dynamic color behavior depends on platform capabilities and should have a deterministic fallback theme
recommendedFor: Material applications that want to follow supported device or desktop accent/dynamic colors
Projects that want Material dynamic-color harmonization while retaining fallback ThemeData

verification.reason: Current pub.dev package metadata and changelog clearly define version 2.1.0 and supported platforms.
